photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 12:31:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1850 s; on-screen clock 04/17/13 12:31:50, wanted 12:31:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-106 12:31:00' on 2013-04-16 (`as run matrix!B99`), read as 2013-04-16 12:31. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-16 plus one day, 12:31: it was found 1800 s into this video, and in no other video.
